blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi Case III ka sawal hai: denominator mein ek linear factor \(x - 1\) aur ek quadratic \(x^2 + 2x + 5\) hai.
Pehla kaam: check karna ke quadratic waqai irreducible hai, warna use linear factors mein torna parta.
Find kya karna hai? Constants \(A\), \(B\), \(C\).
Plan: \(x = 1\) se \(A\), coefficients compare kar ke \(B\) aur \(C\), aur aakhir mein fractions jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x^2 + 15}{(x^2 + 2x + 5)(x - 1)}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Top ki degree 2 aur bottom ki degree 3 hai, is liye fraction proper hai. Ab dekhna hai ke \(x^2 + 2x + 5\) toot sakta hai ya nahi. Is ka discriminant \(b^2 - 4ac = 4 - 20 = -16\) negative hai, yani is ke real factors nahi bante: yeh irreducible hai. Is liye yeh Case III hai: \(x - 1\) ke upar \(A\) aur quadratic ke upar \(Bx + C\).

Partial fractions ki shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{x^2 + 15}{(x^2 + 2x + 5)(x - 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 2x + 5}\]
Kyun: Linear factor \(x - 1\) ke upar ek constant \(A\), aur irreducible quadratic \(x^2 + 2x + 5\) ke upar linear numerator \(Bx + C\). Har factor ki degree se ek kam degree ka numerator aata hai: linear ki degree 1, to upar degree 0 (constant); quadratic ki degree 2, to upar degree 1.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[x^2 + 15 = A(x^2 + 2x + 5)\]
\[+ (Bx + C)(x - 1) \quad \text{(i)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf poore denominator \((x^2 + 2x + 5)(x - 1)\) se multiply kiya. \(A\) ke neeche \(x - 1\) tha, woh cancel hua aur \(x^2 + 2x + 5\) bacha; \(Bx + C\) ke neeche quadratic tha, woh cancel hua aur \(x - 1\) bacha. Yeh identity har \(x\) ke liye sach hai.

\(A\) ke liye (i) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[1 + 15 = A(1 + 2 + 5) + 0\]
\[16 = 8A\]
\[A = 2\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) rakhne se \(x - 1 = 0\) ho jata hai aur \((Bx + C)(x - 1)\) wala term khatam. Sirf \(A\) bacha, aur ek line mein \(A = 2\) mil gaya. Quadratic factor ko zero karne wali koi real value nahi, is liye \(B\) aur \(C\) ke liye coefficients compare karne honge.

(i) ki right side kholein
\[A(x^2 + 2x + 5)\]
\[= Ax^2 + 2Ax + 5A\]
\[(Bx + C)(x - 1)\]
\[= Bx^2 - Bx + Cx - C\]
\[x^2 + 15 = (A + B)x^2\]
\[+ (2A - B + C)x + (5A - C)\]
Kyun: Har bracket khol kar \(x^2\) walay, \(x\) walay aur constant terms ko alag alag ikattha kiya. Jab tak powers ikatthi na hon, coefficients compare nahi ho sakte.
Dhyan dein: \((Bx + C)(x - 1)\) mein \(C \times (-1) = -C\) aata hai; yeh minus aksar chhoot jata hai.

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ 1 = A + B\]
\[B = 1 - 2 = -1\]
\[\text{const}:\ 15 = 5A - C\]
\[C = 10 - 15 = -5\]
Kyun: Identity ke dono taraf ek hi polynomial hai, is liye har power ka coefficient barabar hoga. Left side \(x^2 + 15\) mein \(x^2\) ka coefficient 1 aur constant 15 hai. \(A = 2\) rakh kar seedha \(B\) aur \(C\) mil gaye. Constant wali equation mein \(C = 5A - 15 = 10 - 15 = -5\).

\(x\) ke coefficient se parakh
\[2A - B + C = 4 + 1 - 5\]
\[= 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Left side mein \(x\) wala koi term nahi, is liye us ka coefficient 0 hona chahiye. Humne yeh equation istemal nahi ki thi, phir bhi 0 aaya: matlab teeno constants sahi hain.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{Bx + C}{x^2 + 2x + 5} = \dfrac{-x - 5}{x^2 + 2x + 5}\]
\[= -\dfrac{x + 5}{x^2 + 2x + 5}\]
Kyun: \(B = -1\), \(C = -5\) rakhne se top \(-x - 5\) bana. Is mein se minus common nikal kar \(-(x + 5)\) likha, taake jawab saaf ho aur sign ki ghalti na ho.

Tasdeeq: fractions ko wapas jorein
Common denominator \((x^2 + 2x + 5)(x - 1)\); top:
\[2(x^2 + 2x + 5) = 2x^2 + 4x + 10\]
\[(x + 5)(x - 1) = x^2 + 4x - 5\]
\[\text{Top} = 2x^2 + 4x + 10\]
\[- x^2 - 4x + 5\]
\[= x^2 + 15 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Common denominator \((x^2 + 2x + 5)(x - 1)\) par pehle fraction ka top \(2(x^2 + 2x + 5)\) aur doosre ka \((x + 5)(x - 1)\) bana. Minus karne par bilkul \(x^2 + 15\) aaya, jo asal numerator hai. Jawab pakka sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{x^2 + 15}{(x^2 + 2x + 5)(x - 1)} = \frac{2}{x - 1} - \frac{x + 5}{x^2 + 2x + 5}\)
Book ki answer key mein is sawal ka jawab nahi hai; yeh jawab humne khud nikal kar check kiya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein Sawal 2 ka jawab hai hi nahi. Jis jawab par "2" likha hai, \(\frac{1}{2(1 + x)} + \frac{1 - x}{2(1 + x^2)}\), use jorein to \(\frac{1}{(1 + x)(1 + x^2)}\) banta hai, jo is exercise ka koi sawal nahi. Is liye us jawab se apna jawab match mat kijiye. Sahi jawab, jo upar nikal kar wapas jor kar check kiya gaya hai: \(\frac{2}{x - 1} - \frac{x + 5}{x^2 + 2x + 5}\).
